newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rebounded early in the Friday morning session, after ending on a feeble note on the previous day, brokers said.
They said that foreign investors were especially active buyers, but they were sceptical whether the buying would continue throughout the day.
As of 0027 GMT, the Nikkei average was 234.02 points or 1.17 percent higher at 20,290.33. June Nikkei futures added 260 to 20,320.
"It is just before the weekend so there is likely to be a bit of weakness sometime in the session," Toshio Ogawa at Izumi Securities said.
